SELECT pgs.player_id, pgs.player_name, SUM(pgs.pts) AS total_points
FROM "nba_golden"."dev"."player_game_stats" AS pgs
JOIN "nba_golden"."dev"."games" AS g
  ON pgs.game_id = g.game_id
WHERE g.game_date >= '2030-01-01' AND g.game_date < '2031-01-01'
GROUP BY pgs.player_id, pgs.player_name
ORDER BY total_points DESC
LIMIT 500
